order: follow-up order of 7 October 2026, F5.3: the candidate-list test in the proposal is registered on the single harness
status: REGISTERED ON THE HARNESS - parameters to be confirmed against the proposal text, which is not in the repository

feature_sets.base: 5 price variables (mom_12_1, ret_1m, vol_12m, hi_12m, log_dv)
feature_sets.ext43: the design workspace's 43 variables (scripts/analyst/features_ext.py -> data/analyst/panel_ext_monthly.parquet): 21 price, 22 fundamentals from EDGAR company facts
feature_sets.revisions: an_eps_rev_30, an_eps_breadth_30, an_rev_rev_30 from observed snapshot rows at or after available_from (F4); none until 12 months of snapshots exist

harness.design: S&P 500 members at each month-end from the dated membership file; ranks within the month; 12-month (primary) and 1-month outcomes in excess of the average member; test years 2014-2026 retrained each January on month-ends whose 12-month outcome was complete; ridge (primary) and a boosted tree; top tenth and top fifth after 10 bps a trade; Newey-West t (11 lags at 12 months)

pass_rule: section D2 of the free-analyst-data order: top tenth more than 2 points a year above the average member after costs, Newey-West t above 3, and a positive paired difference against the same model without the variables under test
lookahead_checks: no variable depends on the current membership list (dated file only; no current sector filter)
no row after the month-end enters that month (unit tests)
no provider-reported consensus row enters (referee analyst:provider_rows_in_test, CRITICAL)
pending: the proposal's own candidate list and any parameter it fixes (universe, horizon, feature set, dates) are to be entered here from the proposal text before the run; nothing runs until then
do_not_touch: once a run begins nothing above changes; a change needs a new registration with a stated reason and both results are reported
